comment: The suite skips this module because id_token_signing_alg_values_supported does not include 'none'; OPs are not required to support unsigned ID Tokens, and the toolkit deliberately does not.

The suite skips this module when the OP rejects a request_uri that is not a PAR request URI with request_uri_not_supported, which is the expected outcome: request objects passed by reference are not supported, and discovery publishes request_uri_parameter_supported false.

The suite skips this module when the OP rejects the request parameter with request_not_supported, which is the expected outcome: request objects (OpenID Connect Core 1.0 section 6) are not supported, and discovery publishes request_parameter_supported false.
